subject: Q2 slate — final OKR acceptance + risk sync
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>; Sara Patel <sara@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 slate — final OKR acceptance + risk sync

Team — attaching the near-final slate for Q2 OKRs and the QBR preflight checklist. This is the last pass before we lock owners and publish to the org. High level: the slate reflects the changes we agreed in the owners workshop, but there are three outstanding risk items I want us to acknowledge and decide on today: infra capacity for inference workloads, the rollout cadence for Dedicated customers, and the eval gating for model-quality regressions.

Ask: please review the attached Q2_OKR_Slate_v2.xlsx and confirm by EOD whether you accept the owner assignments and measurement rubrics or whether you need a follow-up breakout. If you accept, I will update the sheet and push to the org doc + send invites for the QBR preflight on Tuesday.

Key notes: 
- Infra capacity: flagged in red on tab 'Platform' — Kimberly, can you confirm whether the Dedicated pool increase is on track for June?
- Customer rollout: Ben, I left a short rollout timeline under 'Customer Motion' — can you sign off or propose edits?
- Quality gating: recommend we add an eval holdback (3% regression threshold) before major model swaps; draft language is on the 'Quality' tab.

Attachments: Q2_OKR_Slate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR_Preflight_Checklist.md (markdown)

Thanks — aim is to publish Friday morning so QBR materials are stable.

—
Rachel Kim
Director, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 slate — final OKR acceptance + risk sync

Thanks Rachel — reviewed quickly and nice work pulling this together. A few quick items: 

1) Infra capacity: the Dedicated pool increase is provisioned in our staging region and we're on schedule for a June 2 soft launch, but I need a quick confirm on the expected QPS shape from Product so we can size autoscaling policies. Can we add the 95th-percentile token/sec estimate to the Platform tab?

2) I see the 'Platform' tab flags a PCI-compliance dependency for a customer pilot. Let's add an explicit action item to the checklist for Security to confirm the audit window; otherwise that pilot can't move.

3) Small edit: the metric under Search relevance is currently additive; can we change the language to 'net lift vs baseline' to match the metrics playbook?

I'm good to sign off on owners after those updates — propose a 30-minute breakout this afternoon with Ben and Rachel to align on QPS and rollout milestones.

—Kimberly
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 slate — final OKR acceptance + risk sync

Appreciate the summary — I'm broadly supportive. A couple of items from the Customer Motion tab: 

- Rollout cadence: propose we split the pilot into two waves (pilot + expansion) rather than a single broad pilot; that reduces blast radius and aligns with Greenleaf's procurement windows. Sara — does that sound reasonable on your side?
- Metrics: I adjusted the north star to be 'inference cost per 1k tokens (p50/p95) + accuracy lift' — see my inline comments in the spreadsheet.
- Eval gating: strong 👍 for a 3% regression threshold, but recommend we also add an automatic rollback policy for the first 48 hours after a model swap.

I can join a 30-minute huddle at 3pm PT.

—Ben
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Patel <sara@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 slate — final OKR acceptance + risk sync

Thanks both — summary below from our sync and next steps. I have updated the sheet and uploaded v3 (see attachment).

Decisions and actions: 
- Infra capacity: Kimberly confirmed staging provisioning; action: Product to add QPS estimates to the Platform tab (owner: Rachel) — due Wed 5/12 EOD.
- Rollout cadence: move to two-wave pilot (pilot + expansion); Ben to update timeline and customer comms (due 5/14).
- Eval gating & rollback: adopt 3% regression threshold + automatic 48-hour rollback on major swaps (owner: Product Strategy / Ben).
- Security checklist: added item for PCI audit confirmation; Kimberly to loop Security (due 5/13).

QBR preflight: scheduled Tue 5/17 10:00–11:00 PT — invite sent. Please confirm if you can't make that slot. I also shared the Drive folder and the HubSpot deal for Greenleaf (HUBSPOT-Deal-3472).

Attachments: Q2_OKR_Slate_v3.xlsx (updated), QBR_Preflight_Checklist.md

If no objections by Friday morning I'll publish the owners and the exec one-pager.

—
Rachel Kim
Director, Product
Redwood Inference
